messages:
incidents_bot: ALERT: GPU pool us-west1 queue length crossing threshold (current ~13,200). autoscaler failure rate elevated. Paging on-call: @casey_oncall @mina_reliability

casey_oncall: ack — joining. Looking at dashboards: queue length spike started ~1950019800, 99pct latency spiking to 6s.

mina_reliability: seeing repeated errors from the scaler: `ErrQuota: allocation denied` and `AttachGPUsTimeout` in the provisioning pipeline. Posting log sample.

mina_reliability: ```
E0504 09:33:12 scaler.go:412] provision failed: AttachGPUsTimeout instance=pool-usw1-672
E0504 09:33:18 scaler.go:420] allocation error: ErrQuota: region quota limit reached
E0504 09:33:29 scaler.go:435] scale request aborted: backoff in effect
```

alex_prod: customers starting to report increased 500s and API stalls on hosted inference endpoints. Support already flagged multiple high-sev tickets. @sasha_support can you list top affected customers?

sasha_support: sharing initial list in DM. Open ticket SVC-7781. We're sending an acknowledgement to impacted customers.

casey_oncall: quick hypotheses: provider quota exhaustion vs a regression in attach step causing leaks. Oliver, can you check pool state and instance counts?

oliver_platform: pool snapshot: desired=140, running=138, attaching=24, errored=9. Inventory shows several instances stuck in ATTACHING_GPU longer than normal (~7+ mins). Provider shows transient maintenance events in us-west.

devon_infra: observed a backlog in provider API calls; our attach attempts queuing and timing out. Also the autoscaler isn't deducting pending attach requests from available headroom, so it keeps trying to create more -> exacerbates quota.

casey_oncall: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause non-critical background workers in us-west1, 2) throttle batch ingestion, 3) reroute some traffic to us-east1 while we recover.

mina_reliability: implemented rate-limit tag for jobs with `priority=low`. Throttled applying config at 1950020021.

oliver_platform: rolling out traffic routing rule: prefer us-east1 when us-west1 avg queue > 9k. Will start gradual failover to avoid cold-start blips.

incidents_bot: config change applied by oliver_platform at 1950020105: routing-policy updated

sasha_support: update to customers: sent initial notice and ETA ~30-45m. Some customers requesting timelines for fix.

alex_prod: can we enable model quantized fallbacks for non-SLA tiers to reduce memory pressure? This helped in past incidents.

casey_oncall: yes — plan: canary quantized fallback for free/standard tiers to 15% traffic, monitor errors. If stable, expand.

devon_infra: starting canary rollout at 1950020180. Also running cleanup job to remove instances stuck in ATTACHING longer than 90s.

devon_infra: ```
# cleanup stuck attaching instances
for id in $(list-instances --state=ATTACHING --older-than=90s); do cloudctl delete $id || true; done
```

mina_reliability: autoscaler logs after cleanup: fewer attach timeouts, some previously-failed CreateInstance calls succeeded. Provider replied they cleared maintenance backlog at ~1950020300.

oliver_platform: after routing and throttles, us-west1 queue down to ~4.5k; overall 5xx rate falling back toward baseline. canary metrics: latencies for quantized fallback +5-10% but error rate unchanged.

alex_prod: expand fallback to 40% at 1950020400. Move carefully.

incidents_bot: ACTION at 1950020400: quantized-fallback expanded to 40% by devon_infra

mina_reliability: monitoring shows autoscaler no longer hitting ErrQuota. Pending attaching instances reduced from 24 -> 3 after cleanup.

oliver_platform: provider confirmed temporary quota throttle due to maintenance and internal backlog; they advised we request emergency quota bump if we want faster recovery windows.

casey_oncall: current state: mitigated but not closed. Proposed immediate follow-ups: keep routing policy active for 2 hours, keep background throttles, continue monitoring for 1h post-stabilization. Agreed?

sasha_support: agreed. Will hold customer comms until final resolution note.

alex_prod: post-incident notes (quick): root cause = provider maintenance backlog causing attach timeouts + autoscaler not accounting for pending attach requests -> retry storm. Contributing factors: large non-tagged batch workloads and lack of provider-maintenance detection.

mina_reliability: proposed action items:
- A1: Add check in autoscaler to include pending ATTACHING instances in headroom calc (owner: devon_infra)
- A2: Auto-cleanup for instances stuck in ATTACHING > 90s (owner: devon_infra)
- A3: Default background jobs `priority=low` and enforce throttles for non-critical workloads (owner: casey_oncall)
- A4: Add provider-maintenance detection hook and pause aggressive scale-ups during provider maintenance (owner: oliver_platform)
- A5: Alert when we reach >80% of region GPU quota and auto-trigger cross-region routing (owner: oliver_platform)
- A6: Postmortem doc + customer impact summary and credits if SLA breached (owner: alex_prod)

ops_pager: logged actions and created follow-up ticket INC-7802-POST for tracking. Owners assigned.

casey_oncall: marking incident mitigated at 1950020500. I'll draft postmortem and link to ticket.

sasha_support: final customer update queued for 1950020800, including summary and next steps.

-- end of thread --
